description: This file implements a Kubernetes namespace controller responsible for managing namespace lifecycle events, including deletion and cleanup of resources within namespaces. It includes functions for enqueuing namespaces, worker routines for processing the queue, and synchronization logic.

classes.name: NamespaceController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing namespace lifecycle events, including deletion and resource cleanup.

methods.name: NewNamespaceController
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new NamespaceController with event handlers and queue.

methods.name: nsControllerRateLimiter
methods.description: Configures rate limiting for namespace deletion retries.

methods.name: enqueueNamespace
methods.description: Adds a namespace to the processing queue if it is marked for deletion.

methods.name: worker
methods.description: Processes namespace items from the queue, handling deletion and retries.

methods.name: syncNamespaceFromKey
methods.description: Synchronizes a namespace based on its key, triggering resource deletion if necessary.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the namespace controller with specified worker routines and manages lifecycle.
